summary: One entry per version of each component of the set view, written by scripts/write-units.mjs from component.json x-history (kind, consumer note, evidence) and the version's migration entry (changes). Former public names are dated in each component's aliases.json.

entries.consumer: Nothing to change for a host. With head="list" a view's filter fields (settings.filter_fields) are put on the head row when it opens, and the default view's from the first answer, whether or not the host echoes filters_chosen; a view that keeps none no longer inherits the fields of the view left. Adding or removing a field of a shared or system view that keeps its fields marks it changed. A board and cards say their count in the footer («1–80 из 120», sf-pagination's range words); host attribute data-sf-view-footer-count while they do. Port: simai.dataview-port 1.16.0 is accepted (1.0.0..1.16.0): saved views of level package read as system (until 2027-01-01); with personal-preferences the page size and the view zone's open state are the person's layer on the host (data.preferences, preferences.save), else the browser as before. Default page size: a page that sets none now asks 20, not 25, and its menu is exactly 10/20/50/100 -- a host that assumed 25 sees per_page 20 in the first query (owner decision 2026-11-20). The «Показать ещё» look's range counts every row on screen («1–12 из 12»). Closing a record the host opened in its own panel gives the focus back to the record's row.
entries.summary: Round 7 (round/view-r7, VS-8, board and cards count; views study e072e2ab): js/head.js chosen falls back to the open view's settings.filter_fields (with the fields of its conditions) when the query has no filters_chosen; _openSavedView writes the view's fields as filters_chosen (or drops the previous ones); viewChanged compares the view's fields with the chosen ones. index.js _drawCountFooter: for layout board and cards the footer start shows the range of the records on screen of view.total in sf-pagination's words (range, range-many, read under sf-pagination; the page size and count offer hidden), the host attribute data-sf-view-footer-count keeps the footer part drawn without a page row; nothing before the first answer, for an empty, failed or refused list or with chrome without pagination. Port 1.16.0 (simai/ui-source feat/view-port-levels 264f42539, dispatcher order 2026-11-20): SUPPORTED_PORT_VERSIONS, x-port.supports and host_port.supported_versions + 1.16.0 (host_port.version stays 1.15.0 until the pinned pair carries the 1.16.0 contract); head.js viewLevel reads package as system; index.js _personalOffered (port >= 1.16.0 and personal-preferences), _acceptPersonal (data.preferences of an answer: zone via ListHead.keptChanged unless the person toggled, a page size other than the first query's asked once more), _savePersonal (preferences.save of the changed fields against the layer revision, one retry on a conflict's current_revision, quiet), keptPreferences prefers the layer, the browser copy kept for the first paint. Round 7 returns of DEV's round-5 acceptance (R5-1, R5-3, R5-4): VIEW_DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE 20 replaces the literal 25 of the initial query, the echo fallback and the revalidation key; _drawFooter takes the range of a page row in appearance more from _shownRangeText (1–N of total, the board/cards count line's text); _watchHostRecordClose hears sf-view-properties-close on the document after a record.open without record-card and, when the focus was lost (body), focuses the record through _focusRecord (shared with the record card's close). The view-config/1 contract is in contracts/view-config/ of the repository.

entries.consumer: Nothing to change for a host. With head="list" the title row holds the list name only (the number of records is the footer's); the head row starts with a quiet view toggle (view_quilt) that opens the view zone below it: the open view's name and menu by level, the display kind, Настроить вид and, when the view is changed, Изменено with save as new, save for everyone (where allowed) and reset. The zone's open state is kept per person under preferences-key. The list menu moved to the end of the head row. Widths follow the text measure (C396): the notice is at most 44 steps (352 px at normal density, was 320) and the places window 52 (416, was 448); the skeleton's search field and toolbar end start from 44 (352, was 320), as the table's.
entries.summary: Round 6 (round/view-r6, VZ-1, owner C393, C394, views study option D): js/head.js draws the title row with the name only (data-count gone), the view toggle first in the head row (sf-button-icon, name and tooltip «Представление: <name>», badge-dot while the open view has unsaved changes, glyph tinted while a view other than the default is open, pressed and aria-expanded while the zone is open; appearance toggle where the page's sheets carry sf-icon-button--toggle, else the own look .sf-view-head-zone-toggle--own with the same tokens), the view zone (.sf-view-head-zone, --sf-outline-variant 1 px, --sf-radius--surface) with the views button (menu by level system / shared / personal with headings), sf-segmented of the kinds, Настроить вид and Изменено (state window: unsaved or mine note, save for everyone, save as new, reset); its open state in SF.Preferences (viewZone) read by keptPreferences, and the first-paint skeleton holds the zone row while it is kept open. «⋯» moved to the head row end. A page row without appearance takes --sf-pagination-divider-color: transparent (the footer draws the line). C396 (round 6): text-container widths moved from --sf-g* to the text measure var(--sf-measure-N, calc(N * var(--sf-text--size-1) / 2)): notice max g0 -> 44, places window g4 -> 52, skeleton search basis and toolbar end min g0 -> 44.

entries.consumer: Nothing to change. The calendar asks its range once: a query whose date field is not known yet leaves window.date_field out, and the answer is drawn as it comes. The footer's page size menu offers 10, 20, 50 and 100 (C388) when the page row has no page-sizes of its own; the page size in force is added when it is not one of them (25 by default). The chosen size is remembered in the browser (preferences-key), as before.
entries.summary: DEV's open item B2 (round/view-r5): calendarQuery leaves window.date_field out until the date field is named, and acceptCalendar no longer asks the same range a second time with the field the first answer named (_calendarAskWithField and the refresh('calendar-range') step are gone). One range query per window. LV-12 (C388): the view writes page-sizes="10,20,50,100" (VIEW_PAGE_SIZES, marked data-sf-view-page-sizes) on a page row that has none.

entries.consumer: Nothing to change for a host: the release number of round/view-r4's 1.23.0 in view 1.9.0. 1.23.1 is the superseded round/view-calendar (DEV's parallel VCL-1..VCL-4, never released), so the released number is above it.

entries.consumer: Nothing to change for a host. New: the list head's display kind switches live between all four layouts of the set (table, board, cards, calendar; switchLayout keeps the marked records and the record card beside, the cards' page size of 24 gives the list's back on leaving them); cards and calendar are no longer shown disabled. Where the pair carries SF.fieldRenderers.filterWindow (C310, FO-5), a filter field of the list head opens the Framework's filter window and draws its summary (colour while active, the number only above 0, the words in the tooltip); without it the head's own window as before. The calendar's view-config/1 keys (span_days, rules) and the host's refusal codes storage_calendar_update_* are read (sf-view-calendar 1.1.0). DEV's round 3 returns: a display kind whose layout is not in the running set (its element neither defined nor a rule the Loader can fetch) is hidden in the head, not shown disabled (VR3-1); the head's menu separators draw as separators (VR3-2). A table or board after the cards or the calendar asks the list's own page size again (it was the page row's default, 25, after the calendar). The first range query no longer carries date_field null: the field comes from layouts.calendar, else the columns, else the host's description, and a range asked before any of them knows it is asked again once layouts.calendar names it (VCL-2).
entries.summary: View round 4 (round/view-r4, the dispatcher's merge of round/view-returns, round/view-cards and round/view-calendar): switchLayout(kind) works over every layout of the registry -- the content element is the layout's own (table, board, cards, calendar), a page's own element of another layout is parked with one console warning, the marked records go over to the new layout (sf-view-board, sf-view-cards and sf-view-calendar take selected) at once and again over the switch's own answer, the board's lanes become the list's records for the others, the calendar draws the known records on their days at once, the cards' per_page (24) gives the list's page size back when another layout is chosen and the window of the left layout is dropped from the query; selection reads the layout on screen. The list head therefore offers cards and calendar enabled when the host lists them. A filter field of the list head (C300, C310): with SF.fieldRenderers.filterWindow {open, summary} in the pair it opens filterWindow.open({anchor, field, value, size}) and applies {action: apply, value} or resets on {action: reset}; null changes nothing; the button reads filterWindow.summary(field, value) {active, count, words}; without it (the pair ui-1ed6b6c9a040) the head's own window as before; a head drawn before the field renderers loaded draws its fields again once they are in. The calendar's move refusal carries the host's code to sf-view-calendar. DEV's round 3 returns: canDrawLayout(kind) answers true for a layout element only when it is in the running set -- defined, or its cl- rule known to the Loader; the head's kinds leave out what the view cannot draw (the disabled segment, its reason caption and the word head-kind-unavailable are gone, VR3-1, DEV's decision). The head's menus pass separators as {type: "separator"}, the key sf-menu-context reads; {kind: "separator"} drew an empty focusable item (VR3-2). The list's page size is kept while the cards or the calendar are on screen (OWN_PAGING) and given back, from page 1, with the table or the board: the calendar's query has no page, and the table after it asked the page row's default. VCL-2: calendarQuery leaves date_field out rather than null (defaultWindow reads layouts.calendar, the columns, then describe().fields), and acceptCalendar asks the range again once the answer's layouts.calendar names the field. The calendar's first paint draws each day at the calendar's new height (the number row and three event lines, VCL-3).

entries.consumer: Nothing changes for a host that writes no layout="calendar". New: layout="calendar" (sf-view-calendar, C307): the query carries window {range, date_field, end_field} and context {timeZone, weekStart, locale}, the undated records are a second query.change with reason undated and window {undated, page, per_page}, a move is record.set {record_id, key, value, patch, revision}; the first paint holds the month grid (CL-2). The list head's calendar settings no longer offer a week start (it is the request's, C293) and write color_field. (round/view-calendar said 1.18.0; renumbered above 1.21.0 when it met round/view-returns and round/view-cards in round/view-r4.)
entries.summary: The layout registry takes calendar (owner decision C307, CA-1): layout="calendar" draws sf-view-calendar in the content slot, with no page row; its first paint holds the calendar's bar and the month of six weeks at the day's own height (CL-2). The query carries window {range: [from, to), date_field, end_field} and context {timeZone, weekStart, locale} (C293); the undated records are a second query.change (reason undated, window {undated, page, per_page}); a move or a stretch is record.set {record_id, key, value, patch, revision} and the answer settles it on the calendar; a + on a day is view.create_record with the date filled; an opened event goes to the record card (C305). The list head's calendar settings write color_field and no week start. (round/view-calendar, which said 1.18.0 over round/view-r2.) The layout setting lists calendar.

entries.consumer: New: layout="cards" draws sf-view-cards over the window {page, per_page: 24} (records, total, has_next); a press on a card opens the record card beside the list. Nothing changes for a table or a board. (round/view-cards said 1.19.0; renumbered above round/view-returns' 1.20.0 when the branches met in round/view-r4.)
entries.summary: The cards layout (owner decisions C297, C306, CD-1..CD-8, round/view-cards, which said 1.19.0 over round/view-r2): the layout registry holds cards -> sf-view-cards, drawn in the content slot with no page row (its «Показать ещё» is under the grid); the query carries window {page, per_page: 24}; «Показать ещё» (sf-view-cards-more) continues the list as Show more does; a card's open goes the way a row's does (the record card beside the list, C305, its card marked current and focused again on close); the selection and the host's bulk actions go to the cards' bar; the data state and why a list is empty go to the cards (sf-empty-state); the first paint holds a grid of cards. The layout setting lists cards. The wiring is view/js/cards.js.

entries.consumer: The list head's «Настройки полей записи» no longer raises entity.fields.save: it opens the first record in the card beside the list in its arranging mode (openRecordSettings()); a page without a card hears settings-open {id: "record-fields"}.
entries.summary: Record card settings (C311 (1), (3); RC-4): «⋯ → Настройки полей записи» opens the first record of the list in the record card straight in the arranging mode (openRecordSettings()): one card arrangement per entity for every layout. The head's own record fields drawer (head-record), its panel and entity.fields.save are gone; the words head-add-field, head-fields-default, head-hidden, head-hide-field, head-show-field, head-no-record-fields and head-record-note with them.

entries.consumer: A host with a board answers the lane totals (the count and the sums its layouts.board totals name) with the first cards of every lane: sf-view no longer asks the sums in a second query.change (reason lane-sums, C304, VR2-9). Nothing else to change. New: openCustomize(); the column head menu under the list head keeps pin, hide and «Все колонки…»; the record card beside the list closes on × and Escape; Alt+Down / Alt+Up step it from the list; the table inside the view gets total and row-offset.
entries.summary: View returns (DEV acceptance of round 2, VR2-1..VR2-9): under head="list" the table keeps its column head menu (sort, Закрепить, Скрыть колонку, Все колонки… and the width, C296) -- data-sf-view-columns="head" on the table where the host keeps personal column settings -- and «Все колонки…» opens «Настроить вид» (openCustomize()); the record card beside the list is closed by the view on its close request (open="false"; it gave the focus back and stayed open); Alt+Down / Alt+Up from the list step the card and move the list's place with it; the list head's windows carry roles (data-sf-role head-sheet, head-record): their path ids are the view's, not sf-drawer-1 of the record card's drawer, with which they shared a portal and drew inside the head; the phone sheet opens (sf-drawer open is a method and was read as the open state); the table inside gets total and row-offset (aria-rowcount total + 1, aria-rowindex of later pages); the board asks the cards and every lane total in one request (window.totals count and the known sums; no lane-sums query, C304); a page table under layout="board" is parked with one console warning; cards size S / M / L, M by default (C306); the layout values list board.

entries.consumer: Nothing to change for a host. New: the list head's display kind switches the layout live (table <-> board) through switchLayout(kind); canDrawLayout(kind); a kind no layout of the set holds (cards, calendar, tree) is shown disabled with its reason.
entries.summary: View round 3: the list head's display kind (Таблица / Доска) switches the layout live. switchLayout(kind) swaps the view-made table or board for the layout's own, parks the page's own sf-view-table (out of every slot, with its filter fields and create items) while a board draws and brings it back with the table, keeps the marked records (a table's marks become the board's and back, also over the switch's own answer) and the record card beside, draws what is already known at once and asks the host once with the new layout's query (a board's lane window). A layout attribute written after the view drew swaps the same way. canDrawLayout(kind) says whether a layout of the set (or one registered) draws a kind; the head shows the others (cards, calendar, tree) disabled with their reason (head-kind-unavailable). A saved view saved as a board opens as a board.

entries.consumer: Nothing changes for a host that writes none of the new settings. New: head="list" (the list head, C297, C299-C301), layout="board" / kanban (sf-view-board over the lane window, C298, C304; lane sums come in a second query.change with reason lane-sums), recordBeside(id, direction) and record-card (the record card beside the list, C305 (4)); the phone first paint of a selectable view holds the list's page box (C296). One number above the round's branches (1.15.0 head, 1.15.1 table, 1.16.0 board and card).
entries.summary: View round 2 (C296, VT-2): the first paint of a selectable view on a phone holds the page box sf-view-table 1.24.0 draws over its list of records. (round/view-r2-table, was 1.15.1) List head (head="list"; owner decisions C297, C299, C300, C301; view round 2 LH-1..LH-10): a title row (name and count, views, display kind on sf-segmented, «Настроить вид», list menu by describe().permissions) and a head row (Фильтр + bookmark, filter fields as joined sf-button + sf-button-icon, Очистить, search up to 20rem, Создать split) drawn by the view from SIMAI Framework parts; windows are sf-popover on a desktop and an sf-drawer bottom sheet on a phone; the field window is the pair's filter template (SF.fieldRenderers.renderFilterField). The table draws no toolbar and no head gear under it. Draft intents of the list head study (section 7) through the same port. Without head="list" nothing changes. (round/view-r2-head, was 1.15.0) The layout registry (owner decision C298, BD-1): layout="board" (alias kanban) draws sf-view-board in the content slot, with no page row; a name outside the registry warns once (it drew the table silently) and still draws the table. The board's first paint holds lanes of a head and cards, not a table (BD-2). A board's query carries window {lanes, per_lane} (BD-4); the answer's lanes, board.moves and board.order_field go to the board; a move is record.set of the lane field, «Показать ещё» a query.change with window.lane. (round/view-r2-board, was 1.16.0) Record card round 2 (C305 (4), RC-5): recordBeside(id, direction) answers the next or the previous record id in the order the view shows (null at the ends or for an id it does not show), so a page that opened a record card from the view steps it with Alt+Down / Alt+Up. Nothing to change for a host. (round/view-r2-card, was 1.16.0) View round 2 merge: record-card names an sf-view-properties panel of the page; a record opened from the table, the list or the board then opens in it beside the list (the view marks itself data-sf-drawer-dock-host when the page marked nothing), its steps go to recordBeside (the board's order is its lanes'), its close gives the focus back to the row; without record-card the host's record.open as before. The board's lane window asks totals ["count"] with the cards; the money sums are a second query.change (reason lane-sums, per_lane 0, totals of layouts.board) after the board is drawn, their line held meanwhile (sf-view-board sums-pending, setLaneTotals).

entries.consumer: Nothing to change. A docked record panel beside a list keeps the list usable without a dim; when the page has no dock host the panel names the sf-view it belongs to. Arranging in a panel narrower than the full step stacks the sections over the fields; beside them the section list takes its content width (--sf-view-properties-sections-width is now its cap). LV-10 (C386): sectionsAs defaults to list with panel and tabs without it. LV-11 (C386): a panel below the full step keeps sections-as (column for list, then the panel is widened: panelWidened, panelWidthStyle writes --sf-drawer-width as calc(step + sections width + gutter) in the drawer's panel-style); arranging there stays stacked (C311 (4)).

entries.summary: C311 (5), the dispatcher's call on RC-6 (round/view-r4): the «⋯» menu has no views submenu for anyone; the person who may arrange keeps the one entry «Вид: <name>» that enters the arranging mode with the picker open; a person who cannot arrange (no view settings from the host, no writable layer, or a view-only surface) and has more than one view gets sf-profile-picker in select-only mode above the fields (profiles not editable, nothing created, no reset; a choice raises view.profile). Port range 1.0.0..1.20.0 (SUPPORTED_PORT_VERSIONS, host_port.supported_versions, the passport's list): the C311 edition is port 1.20.0 (the dispatcher's renumbering; GB12 holds 1.19.0, money C294), and hostSpeaksCardSettings asks for 1.20.0 or later. On a phone the card opens on its tab list, and the chooser stands above that list too. Larena backend contract (c311-reply): VIEW_REFUSALS and viewRefusalText(answer, fallback) say the codes in words (view-refused-*-text, en and ru) for view.create/view.profile/view.publish/view.lock refusals and view.save entry errors (an entry error without kind:key, such as head, becomes the card's message); view.publish conflict stores personal {revision, view} as well as shared; view.lock reads required (Larena's path "required") into profiles[]; the select-only chooser is disabled in a required view. Group build 13 (ui-source integration/pair-next-15 89b0c3b8e) numbers the C311 edition simai.property-view-port 1.22.0 (1.20.0 type templates and 1.21.0 form fields came first; its kit is 1.21.0's 71 cases and the four C311 cases, 75): the range is 1.0.0..1.22.0 and hostSpeaksCardSettings asks for 1.22.0 or later, so a 1.20.0 or 1.21.0 host is offered no card settings.

With a 1.19.0 host: answer view.publish and view.lock where the host offers view-settings and a shared layer; send profiles[].required, view.locked and view.head when known. The card now writes its own edits to the personal layer at once (view.save target personal) and «Вернуть как у всех» resets the personal layer only; listen for sf-view-properties-structure to open your field editor.
entries.summary: Record card settings (owner decision C311 on the levels of C298; RC-1..RC-4, RC-6..RC-10, TB-1): own edits go to the personal layer at once; «Сохранить для всех» (view.publish, merged and cleared by the host, a conflict redraws with «Вид изменился»); «Вернуть как у всех» in the profile picker (resettable) resets the personal layer only; «Сохранить как моё» (view.create shared false) in the head «⋯» while arranging; per-setting locks (view.locked, view.lock from a field or tab «⋯» for those who may write the shared layer; a lock mark «Закрыто администратором»); a required profile (profiles[].required) disables the picker and writes nothing; the head line under the title -- the stage as a tonal badge and up to two fields (view.head; «Показать в шапке», «Стадией в шапке»); the arranging mode: the picker and a one-line hint over the fields, the foot «Готово», «Сохранить для всех», «Отменить» (C157 (3)); «Вкладки» with handles and a «⋯» per tab (name, icon, up, down, hide, delete -- its fields to «Скрытые поля» --, lock); «+ Вкладка» with a «Поля» area; a field moves to another tab from its «⋯ → На вкладку …» at every width; one way to hide a field: the eye and «Скрытые поля» (open in the mode); the field template (variant) is no longer offered (C302 (2)), a layer that holds one is read until 2027-01-01; «Новое поле…» emits sf-view-properties-structure for the host's field editor; outside the mode «Профиль: <name>» enters it with the picker open (the «Вид» submenu stays only for a person who cannot arrange).

entries.consumer: New settings edit, history, modal; events step, history; methods openHistory, editField, step; port intents record.history (capability record-history; sealed fields said, not drawn) with the adapter SfPropertyView.historyFromRevisions and record.neighbours (capability record-neighbours); a save refused revision_moved reads as a conflict; a panel docks beside a list marked data-sf-drawer-dock-host from 64rem (modal="true" keeps the scrim); closing over unsaved entries asks in the card first; seven public --sf-view-properties-* variables, --sf-property-view--sections-width a former name until 2027-01-01.
entries.summary: C305 (1), RC-1: edit = group | group+quick | none (group+quick where the host allows editing). A group edits in sf-form (label above in the panel, beside in the full screen; Save first, a quiet Cancel); a group with a field sf-form 1.3 cannot edit (pickers, uploads, sets) keeps the card's own form. A short field (choice, date, time, yes/no, number) edits in a window at its value and saves one value through group.save. «Изменить всё» in the menu; a press on a long field's value opens its group with the focus on it (VP-19, VP-21); edited fields take the group's width (VP-27). C305 (2), RC-3: history = auto | off. «История изменений» in the menu opens a level of the same panel (C289 head: back line, title, menu, close) with sf-list-timeline by day, newest first, before and after drawn by the field's template, «Показать ещё», «Только изменения полей» / «Все события» in its menu. New port intent record.history {record_id, collection, cursor, kinds, limit} for a host that announces record-history (pages of 20, 50 at most); a field the reader may not see comes as {field, label, sealed: true} and is said as «Значение скрыто», never drawn; SfPropertyView.historyFromRevisions builds the answer from stored revisions. C305 (4): a host that announces record-neighbours names the next and the previous record over its current view (record.neighbours, answered {listed, previous: {record_id}, next: {record_id}}); the step carries it as next_record_id and the card opens it. A save the host refuses with revision_moved (the revision moved, nothing written) is a conflict: the card says so, keeps what was typed and reads the record again. C305 (3), RC-4: the full screen keeps the section column (sf-menu until sf-tabs vertical places its box, VP-26), fields in two columns, the history as a 24rem column from 80rem (VP-22). C305 (4), RC-5: from 64rem the panel docks beside a list marked data-sf-drawer-dock-host (no scrim, the list usable); modal="true" keeps the scrim (VP-23). Alt+Down / Alt+Up ask for the next or the previous record (sf-view-properties-step); the focus stays in the panel. C159 (6): closing, stepping or opening another record over unsaved entries asks in the card first (sf-confirm: «Закрыть без сохранения» / «Вернуться к правке»). RC-6: seven public variables --sf-view-properties-label-width, -row-gap, -group-gap, -sections-width, -side-width, -current-background-color, -saved-background-color; --sf-property-view--sections-width is a former name until 2027-01-01. Every new word is in the language files (C282). RC-7, VP-29: the quick windows draw nothing before sf-popover is defined (no shift at the first paint).

entries.summary: C289 (1), (5), R250: the sections are laid out by width, not by a setting: a panel shows them as an underline sf-tabs line under the head (overflow more, «Ещё (n)»); a panel of size full and a wide inline view keep the section column at the start; on a phone they are an sf-list of rows, each opening its section with «←». sections-as applies to an inline view only. C289 (2), C157 (2): the panel is drawn at a step of the sf-drawer ladder (1/2, 1, 2) or full and never grows; panel-width is a dated former name until 2027-01-01, mapped to the nearest step with a console notice and an SF.deprecations entry. C289 (3), (6), R254: «Удалить» is the last row of the head's «⋯» menu, with «Копировать ссылку» and «Открыть на всю страницу»; a record to read has no foot, and nothing stands on the drawer's edge outside the panel. entries.summary: view-config/1 keys from the Larena backend (msg-75b451e2): calendarOptions reads span_days (31, clamped to 366; how far back the host looks for an event that started before the days on screen) and rules from layouts.calendar; the move rules in force are the rules setting and layouts.calendar.rules. moveCheck: weekdays {days} are the ISO days 1..7 a start may fall on (the host's reading; the round's own 0..6 refused days are gone), locked {field, in} holds a record whose field has one of the values (also with no day), ability is the host's and comes per record in can {update: false, code, reason}; sunday..saturday, min, max and dates are still read. A refusal carries its code; with no reason of its own a rule or a host refusal (storage_calendar_update_past, _weekday, _locked, _denied, _end_before_start, _too_long, _patch_invalid) is said in the pack's words (refuse-past, refuse-weekday, refuse-locked, refuse-denied, refuse-end-before-start, refuse-too-long, refuse-patch-invalid; en and ru); a machine code is never shown to a person. VCL-1: mode resolves the mode attribute only when written, then layouts.calendar mode, then month (getProp answered the property default, month, and hid the setting). VCL-3: «+N» is a plain button (sf-view-calendar__more) at --sf-text-height-1/2 instead of an sf-button of the control height; the day's block-size is padding + one control row + per_day text lines and gaps. VCL-4: the phone row's grid is time | title | auto, the second field on the title line (end), the first under the title, ellipsis on long values. Phone month: renderPhoneList draws «Без даты N» (data-undtoggle, aria-pressed) under the month and the chosen day's list (renderDayList with + in its heading, lday-h[data-picked]) or renderUndatedList (rows with data-ev, the close button data-undclose); phoneUndated is the phone's own state, apart from the saved undated_open, cleared by pickDay; toggleUndated on the phone's month toggles it. A touch held 700 ms on a list row opens openEventMenu (rows do not drag; the click after it is swallowed; a native contextmenu cancels the hold). The pick window (and the phone month panel) also hears sf-change, the name under which the pair's sf-input-date says a chosen day; with sf-input-date-change alone «Перенести на…» moved nothing. Undated phone rows have no time column.
